projects.title: Aura Haute Parfumerie
projects.short_description: Complete luxury brand identity, custom metallic packaging, and international digital launch.
projects.full_description: Aura Haute Parfumerie sought to redefine high-luxury niche fragrances across European and Middle Eastern markets. Upgrade delivered a majestic visual identity featuring hot-stamped gold foil typography, geometric flacon packaging, and a digital flagship that generated over €1.4M in pre-orders.
projects.objectives: Position Aura as an undisputed heritage-tier luxury fragrance brand, commanding €320+ per bottle while differentiating against conventional mass-market conglomerates.
projects.approach: We drew inspiration from classic Parisian architecture and modern architectural minimalism. We synthesized a custom serif typeface paired with brushed gold accents and rich midnight obsidian surfaces.
projects.results: Generated 340% above pre-order forecasts, secured prime shelf space in Harrods and Le Bon Marché, and earned 'Design of the Year' nomination.

projects.title: Nexus Global Wealth
projects.short_description: Ultra-sleek Next.js web application and interactive client portal for private equity advisors.
projects.full_description: Nexus manages over $4.2B in institutional capital. They required a world-class digital experience that reflected immense trust, institutional discretion, and lightning-fast speed.
projects.objectives: Replace a dated legacy portal with a modern, high-security digital interface showcasing portfolio performance, market insights, and private deal access.
projects.approach: Built using Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion with custom real-time data visualization charts, dark-mode financial aesthetics, and encrypted client verification workflows.
projects.results: 210% increase in prospective LP inquiries, 65% reduction in client support load, and 99.8% client satisfaction rating.

faqs.question: What makes Upgrade Marketing Agency different from other creative agencies?
faqs.answer: Upgrade bridges the gap between high-end editorial aesthetics and analytical performance marketing. Many design studios create beautiful art that fails to sell, while performance agencies run ugly ads that degrade brand prestige. We synthesize both: unforgettable luxury craftsmanship paired with ruthless conversion engineering.

faqs.question: How long does a typical branding or website project take?
faqs.answer: A comprehensive brand identity typically takes 3 to 4 weeks. A custom Next.js digital flagship website requires between 4 to 8 weeks depending on custom feature requirements, CMS complexity, and integrations. Accelerated rush sprints are available upon request for time-sensitive launches.

faqs.question: Can we manage website content ourselves after delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. Every website we engineer includes a full administrative CMS dashboard allowing you to add, edit, or delete services, portfolio projects, team members, pricing packages, FAQs, and testimonials without touching a single line of code.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients outside your local time zone?
faqs.answer: Yes, over 65% of our client base spans North America, the UK, Europe, Australia, and the Middle East. Our project workflows are designed for seamless asynchronous collaboration with regular video reviews and dedicated timezone alignment.

faqs.question: What is your payment structure?
faqs.answer: For fixed-scope projects, we typically operate on a 50% initial deposit upon contract execution and 50% upon final approval and handover. For retainer engagements, billing occurs on the 1st of each month with automated invoicing.
